Name: The Wolf - A Spicy Shane Expansion Mod
Author: CacklingxCaracal
Description:
Hi there! First off, thank you so much for playing this mod—it means the world to me that so many of you have connected with it. 

 If you'd like to come hang out with me join my Discord - TheCaracal'sDen https://discord.gg/CJJSrBuXb8 -
this link shouldn't expire
[line]
ALL HUMAN MADE TRANSLATIONS ARE WELCOME - I do not use AI in my mods and do not want AI translations.

I HIGHLY RECOMMEND A NEW SAVE - Some of the events depend on the Jojamart being accessible. 

WHEN SUBMITTING BUG REPORTS: 
I really appreciate a lot of the details provided but I NEED, NEED, NEED SMAPI LOGS, which romance path was selected (not always applicable but helpful enough to rank 'please give me this info'), if you use a modmanager, and if so which one you use! 
 
I recommend using the MH Events mod as a companion mod. It gives more detail about requirements in the events list and offers a force trigger option that doesn't require event commands all within the game menus.

I am also working on making video walkthroughs as well as updating the .txt doc contained within the mod. I currently have the Prologue, The Wolf Path, and The Brat Path done! 
https://www.youtube.com/@scaleymermaid2724

I'm just one lil Caracal juggling this project with life and a few too many mugs of cold coffee—so I get to the issues, troubleshoot, and push updates as I’m able. Thank you for your kindness and patience 

POTENTIAL TRIGGER WARNINGS: implied being recorded w/o consent, stalking, aggressive dominant behavior, unhealthy obsession traits. TO BE CLEAR I do not condone this sort of behavior irl.

It is compatible with Immersive Shane and ARV
Adding other compatibility is on the 'to-do' list :) 

There are 3 path options available via config:

Blush - Do you flush when he says something nasty? 

Wolf - Will you neither encourage him nor dissuade him?
 
Brat - Push his buttons instead?

You can also select 'all romance paths' which will give you all of the paths from the event - this is a pure chaos option.

There is an NSFW toggle for more graphic intimate events.

This mod includes: around 77 new events, at leat 400 lines of dialogue for Shane, as well as some dialogue lines for other villagers as well, custom maps, gifts, weapons, buffs, secret notes, bonus goodies, and food/recipes! It also includes jealousy dialogue for Sterling, Val, and Mirren! 


Go forth rabid Shane lovers and enjoy this man losing his mind over you. 


Thank you to the SDV modding discord  who have saved me time and time and time and TIME again. Ty all. 

More mega thanks to Moth (my wife), LillithsRepose, TwigofWisdom, pamorama, and all the other lovely souls who have been testing my absolute spaghetti plate of a mod since it was just a little baby .zip in a thread. Y'all are the realest. LillithsRepose contributed directly by adding a Conversation Topic for Marnie and DuskyGirl who helped add dating dialogue. I now have a credits.txt  <3

Also, thanks to my husband, who had helped me with copy-editing type stuff as well as working hard so that I can sit here and make this stuff. Till the wheels fall off.
